t: Future-Proof SEO: Thriving with Nix & Quality Content
s: The article argues that future-proof SEO will be driven by AI curation of high-quality, authoritatively written content, emphasizing technical skills and unique digital footprints over reverse-engineering algorithms. The author introduces Nix as a tool for building resilient, platform-independent technical skills and content.
sub: AI-driven content curation and EEAT criteria
Nix for building platform-independent technical skills and content
Importance of unique digital footprints and quality training data for AI
Evolution of search from keyword matching to AI-driven understanding
